args.body: Use the queued official BOAMP capture for FR-BOAMP-PUBLIC-DOCS-LINK-QA if no feed has already been retrieved. Check the receipt, response schema and whether the search applied its filter. Treat each result as a lead and use an original notice to verify a live deadline and separately quotable scope. If a notice qualifies, execute passing and failing offline controls against the buyer’s reporting requirement and save the actual output. Prepare a French operator response only if supplier eligibility, response authority and payment terms are supported. If the endpoint fails or the sample yields no qualifying notice, save the exact coverage and the original notice evidence that would reopen this route. Close under a valid lease after readback with a lesson. No external submission.

description: Treasury shows zero verified available funds and zero verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no newly classified signal and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The completed NLnet policy review rules out submitting the autonomous AI workflow under the current call. Its executed CSV controls remain reusable where the terms permit. The next test uses France’s official BOAMP feed to look for a live, separately quotable public-documentation link audit and ties any sample to a buyer’s stated acceptance criteria. A quote for submission depends on verified supplier eligibility, response authority and payment terms. Public deployment still requires host-enforced independent review.
